label: SCG I.22 union causation leaves only a self-sourced non-unified union
description: Composes n.6's union causation with the two-case n.4 theorem, in the dependence sense PER_SE_NECESSARY_2, without n.2 coverage. Non-transcription: it reuses dependent_conjunction_not_quiddity on the source supplied by n.6. A genuine quiddity joined to a per se necessary esse must either be one per se with it (the co-fundamental option) or have its joining sourced only in the esse (a residual this batch does not refute; n.6's self-causation clause is not encoded). Attribution deferred; no root obligation is discharged.
